title: Why Kim Jong Un Should Want a 4th Summit With Donald Trump
author: James Church
text:
In this Feb. 27, 2019, file photo, U.S. President Donald Trump shakes hands with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un at the Sofitel Legend Metropole hotel in Hanoi, Vietnam, for their second summit meeting.
Credit: Official White House Photo
U.S. President Donald Trump’s push for a fourth summit with Kim Jong Un has so far been rejected by the North Korean leader, who may be playing hard to get. However, based on our decades analyzing North Korea, participation in countless face-to-face meetings with North Koreans – official and unofficial – and numerous visits to North Korea, we think that some in Pyongyang may believe their country could benefit greatly from a fourth summit, though not in terms of what Washington may think. In view of North Korea and Kim’s experience, especially his three summits during Trump’s first term in office, and Pyongyang’s analysis of the president’s current foreign policy, the North Korean Foreign Ministry would emphasize the following points that lay out a strong case with Kim Jong Un for a fourth summit.[...]
